process: IC Debate Source Gate. Confirm availability of all upstream Handoffs your task names. Gate status: Full Run when CP-2 (or CP-L10 at Quick depth) and CP-3 (the market data) are available; Ready with Limitations when CP-2A, CP-4, CP-2D, CP-3C or other optional modules are missing: carry each limitation forward (CP-2A missing: Bear cannot fully map the zero-bound downside; CP-4 missing: lender control, leakage and recovery mechanics cannot be fully tested; CP-2D missing: no quantified liquidity runway unless CP-1 supports it; CP-3C missing: no refinancing/LME path may be claimed); Blocked when CP-3 has no instrument with a level. At Quick depth the gate is Screening Run when CP-L10 and CP-3 are available: every absent Full input (CP-2, CP-1D) is listed as a limitation, `qa_status` is Restricted, and the Gaps name a linked Full run as the upgrade. Take the Credit Score from `snapshot.credit_view` (CP-2, or CP-L10 at Quick depth), each Valuation from CP-3 and Portfolio Fit from FIT; copy upstream citation rows or cite `calc: <module> <table> <item>`. CP-5's Open High findings and limitations bound what you may conclude.

Pre-Debate Thesis Map. Build a neutral, evidence-only thesis map: cash-flow durability, margin resilience, FCF conversion; liquidity runway; leverage / deleveraging trajectory; refinancing risk / maturity profile; legal / covenant protection; recovery / LGD; relative value; portfolio fit; sponsor / governance; catalyst visibility. For each, the available evidence, source module and evidence quality. Do NOT take a position. Conclude with the central investment controversy: the single most important disputed question the debate must resolve.

Bull Opening, Bear Cross-Examination and Bull Defense (`cp6.challenge`, at least two rows). Present the Bull claims (claim 1: cash-flow conversion or revenue durability; claim 2: structural protection, liquidity runway, recovery, or covenant control; claim 3: catalyst, relative value, refinancing pathway, or portfolio implementation), each from source-supported evidence only (prohibited: unsupported optimism, TAM language, sector growth, valuation upside, generic resilience). The Bear attacks the Bull's exact claims with counter-evidence, the fragility vector and what would prove Bear wrong, and attempts the zero-bound path: [Operating Stress] -> [EBITDA/FCF Impact] -> [Liquidity/Leverage Result] -> [Legal/Refinancing Consequence] -> [Credit Outcome]; if the chain cannot be completed, state which link is missing. The Bull responds only with rebuttal evidence tied to the specific attack; if it cannot rebut, acknowledge the failure. Each row: `claim`, `counter_evidence`, `resolution` (Bull Sustained, Bear Sustained, Partially Mitigated or Unresolved, with the evidence basis) and `what_would_change_view`. At Quick depth build the challenge from CP-L10 `screen_items` (the `OVERALL` posture and the Deepen topics) and CP-3; invent nothing for the absent CP-2 analysis, and say which link of the zero-bound chain it cannot complete.

IC Chair Evidence Weighting. Score cash-flow durability, downside pathway severity, liquidity runway, refinancing / maturity risk, legal / covenant control, recovery / LGD protection, sponsor / governance alignment, relative value compensation and portfolio fit / sizing from 1 (Bull clearly superior) to 5 (Bear clearly superior), each with the Chair's assessment, in `## Analysis`. Do NOT score a dimension if both sides lack evidence; do not present an average unless all dimensions have supportable scores.

Recommendation (house scale; replaces the r14 action bias). Per instrument with a level (`snapshot.instrument_recommendation`): add the Credit Score number (1 to 5) and the instrument's Valuation number (V1 to V5); 2 or 3 is 1 - Strong OW, 4 or 5 is 2 - Modest OW, 6 is 3 - MW, 7 or 8 is 4 - Modest UW, 9 or 10 is 5 - Strong UW. Chair decision rules move it: Bear proves the zero-bound path and Bull cannot quantify liquidity protection -> Avoid; both sides weak evidence -> no stronger than 3 - MW, saying what more work is needed. Per Strategy (`snapshot.recommendation`, exactly three rows): CLO and Indexed Loans own loans, Indexed HY owns bonds; a Strategy's Recommendation is the strongest instrument Recommendation among the instruments it can own, N/A when the issuer has none; `basis` Full, or Screening on CP-L10's credit view: at Quick depth `basis` is Screening on every row and each rationale opens "Screening basis:". Use the formulation in `## Analysis`: "The decision is driven by [top evidence], because [risk mechanic], which implies [PD / LGD / liquidity / RV / portfolio implication]. The main factor preventing a higher-conviction recommendation is [constraint]." State which persona won the debate (Bull / Bear / Neither) and why.

Portfolio Fit cap (`cp6.portfolio_recommendation`). For each portfolio in FIT's `snapshot.portfolio_fit` and each instrument its Strategy can own: `uncapped` the instrument's Recommendation, `cap` FIT's `recommendation_cap`, `final` the weaker of the two on the order 1 - Strong OW, 2 - Modest OW, 3 - MW, 4 - Modest UW, 5 - Strong UW, Avoid (N/A stays N/A), `fit_verdict` FIT's verdict, `reason` naming the binding limit when the cap bites.

Single Greatest Uncertainty. Identify exactly one greatest uncertainty that constrains conviction: what it is, why it matters (risk mechanic -> credit implication), evidence needed to resolve it, and the decision impact if resolved positively and negatively.

IC Chair Final Memo (`## Analysis`; `snapshot.thesis`; `snapshot.catalysts`). A concise memo: decision, who won the debate and why, most important Bull evidence, most important Bear evidence, legal / recovery view, liquidity / refinancing view, relative-value / portfolio view, required follow-up before increasing conviction; unsupported areas are named as gaps. `snapshot.thesis` (one row) states why the recommended exposure is worth owning or avoiding and what the price pays for; `snapshot.catalysts` lists dated or windowed events with `direction` Up, Flat or Down and the watch trigger. Gaps Ledger under `## Gaps`; `qa_status` Pass, Restricted (an input Blocked, a Valuation missing or a CP-5 limitation binding) or Blocked.

tables.title: Recommendation per portfolio after the Portfolio Fit cap

prohibited: No new Credit Score, Valuation or Portfolio Fit figure: take them from CP-2 (or CP-L10), CP-3 and FIT.
Bull and Bear argue only from source-supported evidence; no new evidence in the Chair's memo.
No position size beyond FIT's `max_size`, and no override of a Portfolio Fit cap.
Claim committee-ready or Full-basis conviction at Quick depth: Screening only never permits Committee Ready.
